string-array.item: Fix DNS Error (EAI_AGAIN): Resolved DNS lookup failure for Claude Code by dynamically writing resolv.conf and hosts.
Automatic Glibc Path Relocation: Patched glibc libc.so.6 network paths to the app\'s internal sandbox.
Instant AI Hostname Resolution: Embedded static entries for Anthropic and FreeLLM endpoints with zero lookup latency.
Bash Linker & Bionic Isolation: Native shell environment completely isolated from glibc dynamic loader.
